localChanges: Set up a game with no human seat and you watch it instead: the page shows it as one of its civilisations sees it, a bar along the top of the map lets you pick which, and Play/Pause holds the computer players between turns and lets them go again. You can act on nothing, and the game stops at its ending for you to see, where before a game nobody played ran on past it (#607, #606).

log: `turn:hold` stops the loop once the turn under way ends, as a pending game result does, and `turn:release` starts the next turn if one was waiting. An observer watching a game pauses it this way (civ-clone/web-renderer#607). A game that has ended stays with its ending until the players keep playing, held or not, and a new game starts unheld.
